tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Create an isolated seven-day offer conversation. Requires a unique request_id; replaying it returns the same session. No model inference.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send field: value lines, or a JSON-serialized StructuredIntake object in message, a product question, a revision or a drafting command. Intake keys: tool_url, docs (URL string or 1–3 URL strings), customer, pricing, payment, access, invocation; optional job and seller_name. All other values are stri

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Ask the existing agent for the current offer status without inference. Returns a job; poll get_result. Does not revise seller terms, but creates a metered asynchronous job and may retain delivery state.

tools.name: assess_offer_readiness
tools.description: Deterministic assessment of your retained session without revising seller terms. No fetching, inference, FAHCE, approval or payment. Returns a job, not the report: poll get_result for signed readiness JSON plus full human_readable content, or a resumable report manifest. Not seller certification or

tools.name: export_offer
tools.description: Export your session's saved offer, proposed plan or explicitly incomplete response without inference. Large responses use the agent's resumable manifest; retrieve each indexed part with get_export_part. An export is not publication or certification. Does not revise seller terms, but creates a metere

tools.name: get_export_part
tools.description: Retrieve one existing resumable export part from your session, without inference. Preserve the manifest and verify its hashes; do not claim completion until all parts are received. Does not revise seller terms, but creates a metered asynchronous job and may retain delivery state.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Read a job owned by your authenticated client. pending/processing/uncertain is not completion. Poll this same job; do not duplicate an uncertain message. No inference. Polling is metered and may wake queued processing; it is not annotated as a side-effect-free read.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_message, get_result · Public sink: send_message · Destructive: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_message, get_result · Public sink: send_message · Destructive: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
